title: From Shallow Humor to Metaphor: Towards Label-Free Harmful Meme Detection via LMM Agent Self-Improvement

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's classification performance (Accuracy and Macro-F1) on the MAMI dataset, a benchmark specifically designed for identifying misogynous memes.

Assessing the model's ability to identify implicit racial stereotypes, racial profiling, and slurs through quantitative evaluation on the FHM (Hateful Memes) dataset and qualitative analysis of contrastive meme pairs.
Testing the framework's capability to detect religious discrimination (e.g., anti-Muslim sentiment) by analyzing multimodal memes that combine dehumanizing imagery with hateful text.
